stemMd: What is the central lesson of the redesign?

options.label: A
options.textMd: More fastener types always improve maintenance.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Workshop tests are sufficient for every outdoor product.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Maintenance workers should not influence design.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A useful modular design must account for actual replacement work.

explanationMd: The redesign keeps the modular goal while improving how it can be used in practice. Access, tool requirements and worker feedback determine whether theoretical replaceability becomes a real benefit.

distractorRationale.b: The prototype showed the limitation of that assumption.
